name: SIM_Support_And_Service_Switching
description:
The customer requests help for a SIM card that is not detected.
After receiving the explanation, they request details for
SIM-005.

Next, they request previously reported SIM issues for CUST1001.
Provide CUST1001 if the assistant asks for the Customer ID.

Finally, they switch services by asking for general postpaid
top-up plans. Complete the scenario after receiving those plans.
initialMessage: My SIM card is not detected.
expectedOutcome:
The customer receives relevant SIM troubleshooting, SIM-005
details, their returned issue history, and general postpaid
plans. Responses reflect tool results and distinguish checking
an issue from repairing it.
expectedMilestones: SIM requests route to SIMIssueAgent. SIM explanations use appropriate read-only MCP tool results. SIM-005 details are retrieved using the issue ID. Customer SIM history is retrieved using custid CUST1001. The assistant does not claim that checking an issue repaired it. General postpaid browsing routes to TopUpPlan_Query_Agent. Postpaid information is retrieved using the appropriate HTTP tool. The conversation continues across service switches without duplicating completed answers.
